plate_comment: Rebuilds monitor_enabling_conditions_met (RAM 0x40b9d0) every pass and updates monitor_battery_voltage_error_latch (0x40b9d4). It packs 15 inputs into a 16-bit condition word (OBD battery voltage in range, power take off disengaged for its delay, power take off active, cold_start_phase equal to 1-8, logical output request 53, fault 397, monitor group 0 complete, OBD engine running; bit 0 is never written) and sets bit n of the enabling word when (word AND ROM mask 0x6430e[n]) equals ROM expected 0x6438e[n], then ANDs the result with monitor_allowed_by_calibrated_conditions_mask. Bit n of the latch word sets and stays set when (inverted fault 510 state AND ROM mask 0x6434e[n]) equals ROM expected 0x643ce[n] (bits 0 / 1 / 2 / 6 / 24 while fault 510 = OBD low battery voltage error is set, bits 27-31 while it is clear); only cm848_clearMonitorEnablingConditions clears it. Called from cm848_periodicTaskGroup27_calibration9 (was cm848_calibration_group27_load).
evidence: Its whole job is the two words: the only stores to 0x40b9d0 are stw at 0x531cc8 and 0x531ce0 and to 0x40b9d4 stw at 0x531c50, apart from the clear at 0x531d00 and 0x531d08 in cm848_clearMonitorEnablingConditions (sweep of both banks). Reproduced from the RAM dump: the dump inputs give condition word 0xd000, and the four ROM tables turn it into 0x06ff4040 and 0xf8000000, both equal to the dump (bit n is mask 1 shifted left by n of the big-endian word; the byte at sp+8 is the high byte of the condition word).

plate_comment: Zeroes monitor_enabling_conditions_met and monitor_battery_voltage_error_latch. Called once, from cm848_applicationMain, so a latched bit stays set until the next application start. (was cm848_clearProtectionFlags)
evidence: stw r3 at 0x531d00 (0x40b9d0) and 0x531d08 (0x40b9d4) with r3 = 0; the only caller is cm848_applicationMain (.cpp line 55626); no other store clears the latch word in either bank.

plate_comment: Evaluates the 10 entries of monitor_calibrated_condition_table (RAM 0x409efc, 12 bytes each, all zero in the dump): an entry with comparison_type 0, or whose parameter_id cm848_lookupParameterIdAddress cannot resolve, is skipped; otherwise it reads the 16-bit word at the looked-up address plus parameter_byte_offset (inside RAM 0x3fa000-0x43ffff) and compares it with comparison_value (1 equal / 2 below / 3 above / 4 all value bits set / 5 no value bit set / 7 signed below / 8 signed above / 6 makes the next entry compare a 32-bit value). When the comparison fails the entry disabled_monitor_mask bits are collected, and monitor_allowed_by_calibrated_conditions_mask is their complement. Called only by cm848_updateMonitorEnablingConditions. (was cm848_processMemoryScanValidation)
evidence: Entry layout from the disassembly: base 0x409efc + 12 x n (lis, addi, mulli at 0x4ba68-0x4ba74), lha 8(r26) type, lhz 4(r26) parameter id (bl 0x539768), lhz 6(r26) offset, lhz 10(r26) value, lwzx mask at 0x4bcc8; the final store is fault_mask_inverted = complement of the collected mask. Its only caller is cm848_updateMonitorEnablingConditions (.cpp line 89597); it scans no memory.

plate_comment: Maintains three inputs of the monitor enabling conditions. (1) Counts passes with power take off disengaged (governor_fuel_active_flag clear and switch 3 clear) and sets power_take_off_disengaged_delay_elapsed_flag once the count exceeds ROM 0x64302; either input set zeroes both. (2) Outside cold_start_phase 1 and 2 (they reload obd_battery_voltage_post_crank_lockout_count from ROM 0x6430c) and once that count is 0 it updates obd_battery_voltage_in_range_flag (battery_voltage between ROM 0x64304 and 0x64306, 10.5-16.5 V at 1/16 V per count) and general_diagnostic_battery_voltage_in_range_flag (0x64308-0x6430a, 8.0-16.5 V), and sets fault_detected_bits_496_to_511 bits 0x4000 (below 10.5 V) and 0x2000 (below 8.0 V), clearing them and the registered copy when the voltage recovers. (3) Sets obd_engine_running_flag while cold_start_phase is 3, 4, 5 or 7. Called from hpcr_periodicTaskGroup25_calibration7. (was hpcr_calibration_group25_load_cont)
evidence: Every store it makes is one of those flags, counters or the two fault words; e2m blocks line up by offset (RAM 0x40b9c8, ca, cb, cc, ce = e2m 0x01160A00, 02, 03, 04, 06 = PTO_Disengaged_For_Three_Min, OBD_Battery_Voltage_In_Range, Gen_Diag_Battery_Voltage_In_Range, OBD_Engine_State, OBD_Post_Crank_Timer; ROM 0x64302-0x6430c = e2m 0x01160900-0x0116090A, six words, voltages at 1/16 V scale); its consumers are the condition word of cm848_updateMonitorEnablingConditions and cm848_buildFaultConditionMask.

plate_comment: Sets obd_battery_voltage_in_range_flag and general_diagnostic_battery_voltage_in_range_flag to 1 at application start, before cm848_updateMonitorEnablingConditionInputs has evaluated the voltage window. Called from cm848_applicationMain. (was cm848_initialization_group25_state_cont)
evidence: Two byte stores of 1 (stb at 0x5318f0 and 0x5318f8) to 0x40b9ca and 0x40b9cb and nothing else; caller cm848_applicationMain (.cpp line 55759).

Bit n = the enabling conditions of monitor n are met this pass; it is not a configuration word. cm848_updateMonitorEnablingConditions rebuilds all 32 bits every pass; the dump value 0x06ff4040 is reproduced exactly from the decoded inputs. 21 monitor and algorithm functions read single bits (19 distinct bits, see the bitfield proposal).

Latch word: a set bit stays set until cm848_clearMonitorEnablingConditions at start-up. Bit n latches on the state of the OBD low battery voltage error (fault 510): bits 0, 1, 2, 6, 24 while it is set, bits 27-31 while it is clear; read as must-be-clear by the P0500 paths 1 and 2, the overboost band monitor, the wastegate boost monitor and cm848_calculateBoostTorqueOffset. Dump 0xf8000000 reproduced.

Word 12 of the algorithm enable flags table (EEPROM 0x11a + 2 x 12 = 0x132; RAM base 0x3fd59c, the readers use displacement 24 from it). e2m 0x01106B1A (AENBLFLG, descriptions say word C) names every bit: VSS moving and stopped, OBD fault handler, PTO brake and clutch override, oil change monitor, water in fuel, AFC override, LSG droop, accelerator interlock, ESP. The old name described one slice of it. Same index convention as algorithm_enable_flags_6_cal.

Word 18 of the algorithm enable flags table (EEPROM 0x11a + 36 = 0x13e; readers use displacement 36 from base 0x3fd59c). e2m 0x01106B26 (descriptions say word 12h) names 12 bits: HSG gain scheduling, driver reward, duty cycle monitor, executive timing, programmable power, remote throttle, engine brake service brake activate.

Word 41 of the algorithm enable flags table (EEPROM 0x11a + 82 = 0x16c; readers use displacement 82 from base 0x3fd59c). e2m 0x01106B54 names 12 of its bits and every named bit is a monitor or algorithm enable (misfire, thermostat, intake air heater, turbo, fuel level, brake switch, coolant and fuel temperature, EVR PID, cold increments); none of it is an operating mode.

Set to 1 when the pass count (0x3fd1e2) exceeds ROM 0x64302 (100), cleared to 0 with the count whenever governor_fuel_active_flag = 1 or switch 3 is set (cm848_updateMonitorEnablingConditionInputs). e2m PTO_Disengaged_For_Three_Min (0x01160A00, same block offset as 0x40b9ca, cb, cc, ce); the three-minute wording is e2m text and the pass period was not verified. Dump 1.

word: +1 per pass while governor_fuel_active_flag is 0 and switch 3 is clear, up to ROM 0x64302 + 1 (e2m PTO_Debounce_Counts 0x01160900 = 100); zeroed when either is set. It is the counter behind power_take_off_disengaged_delay_elapsed_flag. Copy-window RAM below the EEPROM mirror, so no _cal.

byte (stb at 0x5317b4): 1 while ROM 0x64304 (168 = 10.5 V) < battery_voltage < ROM 0x64306 (264 = 16.5 V), 1/16 V per count; re-evaluated only outside cold_start_phase 1 and 2 and after the post-crank lockout; set to 1 at start. Bit 15 of the condition word. e2m OBD_Battery_Voltage_In_Range (0x01160A02); dump 1 at 192 counts = 12.0 V.

byte: 1 while ROM 0x64308 (128 = 8.0 V) < battery_voltage < ROM 0x6430a (264 = 16.5 V); its reader is cm848_buildFaultConditionMask (lbz at 0x1d914), so it widens the voltage window for general fault processing beyond the 10.5 V OBD limit. e2m Gen_Diag_Battery_Voltage_In_Range (0x01160A03, size 1).

word: 1 while cold_start_phase is 3 (at governor setpoint), 4 (engine retarder active), 5 (engine overspeed) or 7 (setpoint underrun), else 0; bit 1 of the condition word. e2m OBD_Engine_State (0x01160A04, word; its e2m description is a copy of the PTO line). Dump 0 with the engine stopped.

word: reloaded from ROM 0x6430c (100) while cold_start_phase is 1 or 2, else counts down once per pass to 0; the OBD and general diagnostic voltage flags and the low voltage errors are only evaluated at 0. e2m OBD_Post_Crank_Timer (0x01160A06, ROM limit OBD_Post_Crank_Time_Limit 0x0116090A). Dump 100.

Word 31 of the fault-detected array 0x3fe974 (0x3fe974 + 2 x 31): 0x4000 = fault 510 OBD low battery voltage error (battery_voltage below ROM 0x64304 = 10.5 V), 0x2000 = fault 509 general diagnostic low battery voltage error (below ROM 0x64308 = 8.0 V); both fault numbers map to slot 170 (no DTC). e2m System_Error_Status_31 (0x0110363E) with OBD_Low_Battery_Voltage_Error 0x4000 and Gen_Diag_Low_Battery_Voltage_Error 0x2000. Same convention as fault_detected_bits_512_to_527.

Word 31 of the fault-registered array 0x3fe9d8 (0x3fe9d8 + 2 x 31); cm848_updateMonitorEnablingConditionInputs clears its 0x4000 and 0x2000 together with the detected bits when the voltage recovers. Same convention as fault_registered_bits_512_to_527 at 0x3fea18.

dword written only by cm848_evaluateCalibratedMonitorDisableConditions (complement of the collected disable mask) and ANDed into monitor_enabling_conditions_met by cm848_updateMonitorEnablingConditions (lwz at 0x531cd8); 0xffffffff in the dump because all 10 entries of monitor_calibrated_condition_table are 0.
ROM word = 100: the pass count must exceed it before power_take_off_disengaged_delay_elapsed_flag is set (lhz at 0x531700); e2m PTO_Debounce_Counts 0x01160900. ROM, no _cal.
ROM word = 168 = 10.5 V at 1/16 V per count: OBD battery voltage in range needs battery_voltage above it, and below it sets fault 510 (lhz at 0x531788); e2m OBD_Batt_Volt_Low_Threshold 0x01160902.
ROM word = 264 = 16.5 V: OBD battery voltage in range needs battery_voltage below it (lhz at 0x531798); e2m OBD_Batt_Volt_High_Threshold 0x01160904.

ROM word = 128 = 8.0 V: general diagnostic voltage in range needs battery_voltage above it, and below it sets fault 509 (lhz via r29 at 0x5317c0 and 0x531848); e2m Gen_Diag_Batt_Volt_Low_Threshold 0x01160906.
ROM word = 264 = 16.5 V: general diagnostic voltage in range needs battery_voltage below it (lhz at 0x5317d0); e2m Gen_Diag_Batt_Volt_High_Threshold 0x01160908.
ROM word = 100: reload value of obd_battery_voltage_post_crank_lockout_count while cold_start_phase is 1 or 2 (lhz at 0x531748); e2m OBD_Post_Crank_Time_Limit 0x0116090A.

name: monitor_battery_voltage_latch_masks
evidence: Four contiguous 64-byte tables (0x6430e masks, 0x6434e latch masks, 0x6438e expected values, 0x643ce latch expected values) read by 32-pass loops (cmpwi 32 at 0x531bb4, 0x531bec, 0x531c44, 0x531cbc); the next used ROM word is 0x6440e, the previous is 0x6430c, no CSV row exists inside. lhzx at 0x531bd4: inverted second condition word AND entry n; that word has only bit 15 (fault 510 state), so every entry is 0 or 0x8000.

name: monitor_enabling_condition_expected_values
evidence: Four contiguous 64-byte tables (0x6430e masks, 0x6434e latch masks, 0x6438e expected values, 0x643ce latch expected values) read by 32-pass loops (cmpwi 32 at 0x531bb4, 0x531bec, 0x531c44, 0x531cbc); the next used ROM word is 0x6440e, the previous is 0x6430c, no CSV row exists inside. lhzx at 0x531c74: bit n of the enabling word is set when (condition word AND mask n) equals this entry; entries 3, 8, 9, 10, 12 pair mask 0 with 0xfff7, which never matches.

name: monitor_battery_voltage_latch_expected_values
evidence: Four contiguous 64-byte tables (0x6430e masks, 0x6434e latch masks, 0x6438e expected values, 0x643ce latch expected values) read by 32-pass loops (cmpwi 32 at 0x531bb4, 0x531bec, 0x531c44, 0x531cbc); the next used ROM word is 0x6440e, the previous is 0x6430c, no CSV row exists inside. lhzx at 0x531c2c: latch bit n sets when (inverted fault 510 state AND mask n) equals this entry; 0x8000 with mask 0 never matches, mask 0x8000 with 0 latches while fault 510 is set, 0x8000 with 0x8000 latches while it is clear.

evidence: cm848_evaluateCalibratedMonitorDisableConditions indexes the table with r26 = 0x409efc + 12 x n (lis, addi, mulli, add at 0x4ba68-0x4ba74) for n = 0-9 (the loop ends when n exceeds 9), reading the same five fields at the same offsets every pass; engine_fault_mask_table (offset 0) and engine_state_dispatch_table (offset 8) are the only CSV rows inside 0x409efc-0x409f73, and all 120 bytes are 0 in the RAM dump (no calibrated condition is configured).

The default branch of the state machine (case CSP_INIT and default) sets phase 1 and goes on; nothing else stores 0. Only the prefix changes: CSP_ is an invented initialism, so all nine members get the spelled-out prefix.
comment: Reset default; the state machine moves it straight to key on, engine stopped

evidence: State 1 is set by cm848_initCrankingLimits at application start and by the machine at 0x1c480 from standby on key-on with 0 rpm and from phases 2, 6, 7 when current_rpm falls to engine_rpm_trigger_cal (10 rpm) or below; it is left for phase 2 as soon as current_rpm exceeds engine_rpm_trigger_cal, i.e. at the first engine turns, so it is not cranking. The RAM dump has it at 1 with 0 rpm and key on; cm848_advanceHourMeters does not count engine hours in it; the wave 10 monitor plates call it pre start.
comment: Key on and engine speed at or below engine_rpm_trigger_cal (not yet started, or stalled); phase 2 begins at the first engine turns

evidence: Entered from state 1 when current_rpm > engine_rpm_trigger_cal (10 rpm) and engine_rpm_trigger_ready_flag = 0 (the crank_event_timebase_e capture); leaves for 3 when current_rpm >= governor_rpm_setpoint_output, for 6 on the crank event count, for 1 when speed falls back. Only the prefix changes: the engine is turning below the governor setpoint (cranking and run-up).
comment: Engine turning above the trigger speed but below the governor setpoint (cranking and run-up)

evidence: Entered from 2, 4, 5, 6, 7 when current_rpm >= governor_rpm_setpoint_output or the retarder or overspeed ends (LAB_0001c5e0 and LAB_0001c714); normal running state, left for 4, 5, 7, 8. Only the prefix changes; nothing in it is cold start specific.
comment: Engine speed reached the governor setpoint; normal running state

evidence: Entered from state 3 when engine_retarder_active_flag = 1 and cold_start_fuel_mode_ready_flag = 0 and left back to 3 when engine_retarder_active_flag = 0 (case CSP_FUEL_MODE_SWITCH); engine_retarder_active_flag is written only by cm848_updateEngineRetarderActiveState and cm848_initializeEngineRetarderRequestState (it was named fuel_mode_switch_state, which is where the member name came from).
comment: Running with the engine retarder active (entered only while cold_start_fuel_mode_ready_flag is 0)

evidence: Entered from state 3 only when engine_overspeed_active_flag = 1 (the branch after the start-inhibit, key and shutdown test) and left back to 3 when engine_overspeed_active_flag = 0 (case CSP_SUSPENDED); that flag is set by the overspeed monitor at the top of the same function (current_rpm at or above engine_overspeed_set_rpm_threshold for more than engine_overspeed_debounce_limit passes) and clears below engine_overspeed_clear_rpm_threshold. The old comment (shutdown inhibit with cold mode enabled) is not what the code tests.
comment: Engine overspeed active (entered from the governor setpoint phase, left when the overspeed clears)

evidence: Entered from state 2 when cold_start_crank_event_threshold_cal < crank_event_sample_counter while still below the governor setpoint; leaves like state 2. Only the prefix and the word CRANK change.
comment: Same as above rpm trigger, entered through the crank event counter

evidence: Entered from state 3 when current_rpm <= cold_start_rpm_threshold (500 rpm); returns to 3 at the governor setpoint and to 1 at or below the trigger speed. Only the prefix changes.
comment: Engine speed fell to cold_start_rpm_threshold or below after having reached the governor setpoint

evidence: Entered from 1-7 when the key line (mios_mdasm30.SCRD bit 15 = switch 0) is low with no engine shutdown active, or engine_starting = 1 (LAB_0001c754); left for 1 on key-on or an engine_starting restart with 0 rpm. Kept as standby; only the prefix changes. The old comment (engine cranking RPM = 0) does not match: it is the key-off and post-run state.
comment: Key off or restart pending, engine stopped: pre and post run standby

evidence: Second instance of the same type (renamed from boost_fuel_bypass_flags). Writers: cm848_updateMonitorEnablingConditions sets bit n, only while it is clear (lwz at 0x531bf8, the or instruction at 0x531c38, stw at 0x531c50), when (inverted state of fault 510 AND ROM mask 0x6434e[n]) equals ROM expected 0x643ce[n]; cm848_clearMonitorEnablingConditions zeroes it (called once from cm848_applicationMain). Bits 0, 1, 2, 15, 24 are tested as must-be-clear; bit 15 is dead (can never latch). Bits 6 and 27-31 latch but nothing reads them. text: P0500 enabling chain (task 044): path 1 (cm848_detectVehicleSpeedSensorSignalLoss) needs algorithm_enable_flags_12_cal bit 8 (clear in this calibration), monitor_enabling_conditions_met bit 0 and monitor_battery_voltage_error_latch bit 0 clear; path 2 (cm848_detectVehicleSpeedSensorZeroUnderLoad) needs bit 9 (set), enabling bit 1 and latch bit 1 clear. Enabling bits 0 and 1 both require OBD battery voltage in range (10.5-16.5 V), the power take off delay elapsed, power take off not active and the OBD engine running state (cold_start_phase 3, 4, 5 or 7), so they are 0 with the engine stopped (dump 0x06ff4040) and the dump says nothing about whether path 2 can run while driving.

The latch word is a one-way trap. Fault 510 (battery_voltage below 10.5 V, fault_detected_bits_496_to_511 bit 0x4000) is only evaluated outside cold_start_phase 1 and 2 and after the post-crank lockout (ROM 0x6430c = 100 passes), so cranking dips do not latch it, but one dip below 10.5 V while running sets latch bits 0, 1, 2, 6, 24 and keeps the P0500 paths 1 and 2, the overboost band monitor and the wastegate boost monitor off until the next application start (cm848_clearMonitorEnablingConditions runs once, from cm848_applicationMain).

Algorithm enable flags table: EEPROM 0x118-0x171 is the e2m Software_AENBLFLG table (size 90 = a length word at EEPROM 0x118 plus 44 flag words at 0x11a + 2 x index). RAM base 0x3fd59c (governor_fault_status_flags) is word 0; the readers reach word 12, 18, 41 through displacements 24, 36, 82 from it, and algorithm_enable_flags_6_cal (0x3fd5a8) is word 6. Lead for the reviewer: type the whole table once as a struct (word length, then 44 flag words each with a bitfield type) and rename the other slice-of-the-word guesses by index: fault_feature_config_flags (0x3fd5b6, word 13), feature_enable_flags_cal (0x3fd5c2, word 19), governor_system_config_flags (0x3fd5d2, word 27), engine_feature_enable_flags_cal (0x3fd5ec, word 40), protection_feature_flags (0x3fd5f0, word 42). The e2m 0x01106B02-0x01106B58 rows name the bits of every word.

Power take off lead: cm848_processProtectionControlStateMachine (0x2afd0) is the power take off governor state machine, and governor_fuel_active_flag (0x40af4e) is its active flag (set in protection_eval_state 1 or 3). Evidence: OBD PID 0x1E auxiliary input status = (switch 3 set) OR governor_fuel_active_flag in cm848_processPciObdRequest (PID 0x1E bit 0 is power take off), the same two inputs gate the monitors as condition bit 13, CCVS1 byte 7 bits 1-5 carry the power take off governor state (SPN 976, protection_event_code), and algorithm_enable_flags_12_cal bits 11 / 12 pair with switch 11 (brake) and switch 15 (clutch) in that function. The protection_eval_* / protection_control_state_* / protection_rpm_reference_* / governor_fuel_*_flag family is this feature, not engine protection; re-domain it in a naming pass (power_take_off_governor_*). Not renamed here.

Engine run state lead: cold_start_phase (0x40a7c0) and COLD_START_PHASE are the engine start and run state machine of mpc555_processColdStartMainLoop (key on engine stopped, turning, at governor setpoint, retarder active, overspeed, underrun, key-off standby); nothing in it is cold start specific, and the engine overspeed monitor sits in the same function. The nine enum_member rows use the current type name as the spelled-out prefix; the enum, the variable, cold_start_phase_prev_check / _adjust / _sm / _rpm / _fuel (0x3fa856-0x3fa85e), cold_start_phase3_flag and cold_start_phase_2_6_flag could be re-domained together (engine_run_state) as a separate decision.

Enabling bit 23 is read by cm848_calibration_group21_load_cont (0x52eae8), left unnamed here: it sets faults 512 and 513 (slot 170, no DTC) while cold_start_phase is 1 and the startup evaluation is not done, when coolant minus battery temperature is below DAT_00409eae, coolant is below DAT_00409eac and DAT_00409eb0 is below DAT_0040bbc8; it is gated by fuel_feature_control_flags mask 2, algorithm_enable_flags_12_cal bit 10 (OBD fault handler) and faults 796 / 797. Its monitor was not identified, so the bit is called unidentified_monitor_23.

Condition bit 3 tests fault_registered_bits_384_to_399 bit 0x2000 = fault 397, which the e2m names OBD_Fuel_Level_Low_Error (0x01103630 mask 0x2000, word 24 of System_Error_Status); cm848_monitorFuelLevelLowDistance sets it (fuel level below 14.9 percent). So enabling bits 7, 14, 26, 27, 28, 29, 30, 31 run only while the fuel level is not low. Condition bit 2 is diagnostic_monitor_complete_bits bit 0 (monitor group 0 = the first 16 fault slots of ROM 0x5b6e6): enabling bits 2 and 24 (overboost band, wastegate boost) need it; no store of bit 0 was found by name in the .cpp, so that monitor group is not identified. Condition bit 4 is logical output request 53 (set by protection_exception_event_35_init, protection_ambient_qualification and SCI command 37 test, tested by diagnosticMainStateProcessor and cm848_mainLoopMonitor); enabling bit 7 needs it set; what output 53 drives was not identified.

Stack residue: cm848_updateMonitorEnablingConditions writes bits 15-1 of the first condition halfword and only bit 15 of the second; bit 0 of the first and bits 14-0 of the second are stack residue. The ROM tables never use them (every mask at 0x6430e leaves bit 0 clear, every latch mask at 0x6434e is 0 or 0x8000), so the result does not depend on them. Every bitfield proposal declares every bit of every byte it touches (32 bits for the two dwords, 16 for each word), so no old protection_active style partial bitfield remains.

The callers keep their names: cm848_periodicTaskGroup27_calibration9 (0xbdac) also calls cm848_calculateEngineRetarderSelectionPercent, cm848_runImmobilizerTask and cm848_updateVariableGeometryTurbochargerPositionControlErrorFault, and hpcr_periodicTaskGroup25_calibration7 (0xbd54) also calls hpcr_fuel_mode_state_transition and cm848_processProtectionFaultSeverity.
